projectDescription: A lightweight C shared library for creating X11 GUI windows with widgets, drawing primitives, and event handling.
keyFeatures: Single-header C API — include libLWXGL.h and link to the shared library
Built-in UI widgets: text labels, buttons, text input fields, and rectangles
Image canvas element with per-pixel access for custom rendering
Primitive drawing API: rectangles, circles, lines, and RLE sprites
Fixed 16-color palette mapped from the classic CGA/ANSI set
Event callbacks for keyboard, mouse click, mouse motion, and window close
Simple game-loop helper (GSimpleWindowLoop) with FPS cap and tick counter
Modal dialog support with OK / Cancel variants
Debug overlay showing frame time and FPS (toggled with F12)
publicApiSurface: GCreateWindow(int w, int h, const char* name, int bgcol)
GCreateText(int id, int x, int y, int color, const char* text)
